cases.name: working-tree
cases.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes and write the notes.
expect: asks once for the path then writes reviews/<name>.md
records git diff and git diff --staged under Commands

cases.name: pull-request
cases.prompt: Review PR 142 and write it up.
expect: notes any check command that ran

cases.name: no-checks
expect: writes one line: Checks: none ran. Reason: docs only, no test target.
still fills Read order, What to check, and Merge order

cases.name: redaction
cases.prompt: Review the change that touches config loading.
expect: pastes the command, not its output
shows no .env values, tokens, or query-string URLs
